description: Returns custom hostnames on one slug, or on every site the token owns when slug is omitted. Inputs: token, and optional slug. Status is the last checked value.

slug.description: Optional slug you own. Omit to list every hostname on this token.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: list_domains
title: List custom domains
